title: Language Center Franchise Opportunity
name: Lingua Learn, 50 Franchisees, Est'd in 2020, Canterbury HQ
description: Lingua Learn is an online language school offering 45+ languages and has over 50 Franchise hubs worldwide in 6 continents. We have over 400 teachers across the globe. We are a global online education brand specialising in accessible, instructor-led language and professional-skills training. It offers live courses in more than 20 languages, over 60 soft-skills programmes, corporate language training, professional development, and tuition for adults, children, and academic students. Classes are delivered by qualified, often native-speaking instructors through group or private formats. Each franchise will have very low overheads as all the classes are conducted online and teachers are paid per class and not hired on a full-time basis. We possess Company Registration as part of the compliance requirement.
